physics_and_domain.selective_mesh: Opt-in fixed quarter-root plan, uniform levels-1 followed by marked-edge Roche midpoint projection and conforming red/green 2/3/4-child triangulation. Original four-quarter symmetry/ancestry; levels1-3,40kfaces/component,128snapshotphases and existing circular detached unspotted/nonpulsating q/spin/radius/state domain.
physics_and_domain.fixed_plan: Pilot ranks original-max-normalized root-group finite changes using nominal sigma across all supplied bands/phases, folded over quarters. Freeze before subsequent candidates; no per-proposal replanning. Topology hashes allow physical vertex movement but forbid seed index reassignment. No physical field/prediction caching. Explicit mask weights/grid are numerical design choices, not posterior adaptation.
physics_and_domain.correction: Density-matched base_angle*sqrt(base_faces/new_faces) passed to original scalar correction is an explicit unvalidated mixed-grid convention. Coarse/fine ablations change only its angle on identical raw selective topology; all coupled physics then rebuilt. OriginalCPU defaults unchanged.
physics_and_domain.hybrid: CPU original seed, selective roots/triangulation, orientation/hulls/eclipse coverage and parent grouping; fresh device corrected state/full-donor tiled reflection/integration and BB emission. CK04 uses originalCPU radiance/LD. No all-GPU claim.
physics_and_domain.unsupported: Fixed seed-topology or refined numeric/resource failure aborts standalone numerical protocol outside candidate handlers, no coarse substitution or physical-prior cut. Existing public CPU/hybrid/native fallback semantics unchanged. No selective public fit or sampler backend.
physics_and_domain.parity: Independent originalCPU state/thermal/tiled NumPy-Numba reflection and unchanged Observer/router; newtests compare per-face points/centres/normals/areas/gravity/logg/temperatures under unchanged3e-13relative/64epsabsolute gates, plus complete curves. Raw physicalflux3e-13relative/zeroabsolute; normalized3e-13relative/2e-12absolute. No gate relaxed.

independent_geometry_and_normalization.angular: Gauss-Legendre mu and periodic phi on full sphere, originalCPU Brent equipotential roots and independent original analytic gradient. dA=r²|gradPhi|/(gradPhi dot radial)dOmega and dV=r³/3dOmega. Sphere area/volume controls, separate16/32orders. Star-shaped inner branch/radius/domain guards explicit.
independent_geometry_and_normalization.geometry: Raw closed triangulation area/volume in SMA²/SMA³ compared with independent angular integrals; ratios dimensionless; scalar correction area and volume scale asfactor²/factor³. Converged geometry is not continuum eclipse, radiance, spectral, likelihood or astrophysical accuracy.
independent_geometry_and_normalization.normalization: OriginalCPU raw observed curves and original maximum normalization, with direct original normalized positive control. Snapshot totals converted through original thirdlight/distance operations. Raw scale changes remain separately visible rather than hidden by normalized agreement.
independent_geometry_and_normalization.error_enclosure: Original finite component/root enclosures and data-dependent likelihood bound retained, with explicit allow_same_level alternate-topology comparison sharing physical/seed/source identity. Budget uses nominaly_err independently of ln_f. Same-grid parity and same-level finite pass never imply continuum certification.

scientific_assessment.outcome: Selective root indicators plus a global density correction do not qualify accuracy at1e-4 and can worsen complete-curve differences despite more faces. Original correction calibration and finite group indicators do not transfer automatically to mixed topology. Changing global scalar alone does not establish a repair. Negative controls retained, not reclassified as prior failures.
scientific_assessment.controls: PartialBB25/50/75percent selected root patches, random same-root-count control (actual green-face counts differ), identical-topology coarse/fine correction ablations; totalBB and partialCK04 50percent controls. Original both eclipses/contact-focused phases/repeats/phase shift/thirdlight, V/bolometric and different native1.5deg finite grid.
scientific_assessment.observations: Same fixed plan across temperature/inclination/thirdlight/noise proposals; original serializer/phase-JD mapping/constraint/prior/reducers/mean/noise/density and independentCPUcallbacks. Shape-index topology changes explicitly abort; no claim of broad fixed-plan validity over q/potential changes. Out-of-prior controls remain original -inf without numerical work.
scientific_assessment.fitting_limit: All new numerical preflights still abort; no optimized selective fit, chain mixing, convergence or ESS/sec assessment. Existing fullsuite public fits/sampler equivalence revalidated. No continuum/finite-exposure/physical-systematic qualification.
scientific_assessment.next: Replace empirical global mixed-grid correction/indicators with independently validated curved-surface quadrature and consistent eclipse boundary integration before1e-4 physical-fit qualification.

timing_conditions.matched: Same unit/process, affinity0-15/Nice10, threads1,FP64; explicit JAXCPU/GPU devices and identical host snapshot plus raw-curve or mapped-density outputs. Full fresh physics/all per-call transfers/host grouping charged. Constructors and potential device initialization outside model timers, inside mainwall.
timing_conditions.setup: OriginalCPU reference work, pilot uniform curves, planfreezing, independent angular/geometry controls, parity/enclosure/cross-grid reports and conversions inside mainwall. A fixed plan does not remove its setup/qualification cost. GPUprofileCPU and GPU runs follow same originalCPU references; single measurements, possible process shape/source-cache reuse, not throughput distributions.
timing_conditions.startup: Driver mainwall starts after imports; separate full commandwalls include Python/import startup. Allocation includes extra GPU probe and safety overhead. IndependentCPU curve outputs smaller than snapshots; not a matching speedup baseline.
timing_conditions.inference: Accuracy failures prevent interpreting any measured cost ratio as qualified physical-fitting throughput or ESS gain. CPU development runs on cores16-19/Nice19 excluded from matched evidence.
